3.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon & Turn the Unholy
3.description: Sacred Weapon adds +CHA modifier to weapon attacks for 1 minute; Turn the Unholy turns Fiends and Undead within 30 ft.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.description: You and allies within 10 ft (30 ft at L18) cannot be Charmed while you are conscious.

15.name: Purity of Spirit
15.description: You are always under the effects of the Protection from Evil and Good spell.

20.name: Holy Nimbus
20.description: Action sheds 30-ft bright sunlight dealing 10 Radiant damage to foes starting turns inside & Adv on saves vs Fiend/Undead spells (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath & Turn the Faithless
3.description: Restrain a foe with spectral vines or turn Fey and Fiends within 30 ft.

7.name: Aura of Warding
7.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft (30 ft at L18) have Resistance to damage from spells.

15.name: Undying Sentinel
15.description: Drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP once per Long Rest and suffer none of old age's drawbacks.

20.name: Elder Champion
20.description: Transform for 1 minute to regain 10 HP/turn, cast Paladin spells as Bonus Actions, and impose Disadvantage vs your spells (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy & Vow of Enmity
3.description: Frighten/halt an enemy (Adv on Fiends/Undead) or Bonus Action grants Advantage on all attacks vs one foe for 1 minute.

7.name: Relentless Avenger
7.description: Move up to half your speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks immediately after hitting with an Opportunity Attack.

15.name: Soul of Vengeance
15.description: Reaction allows a melee weapon attack when your Vow of Enmity target makes an attack.

20.name: Avenging Angel
20.description: Grow angelic wings (60 ft Fly speed) and project a 30-ft aura of menace for 1 hour (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence & Guided Strike
3.description: Frighten creatures within 30 ft or add +10 to a weapon attack roll.

7.name: Aura of Conquest
7.description: Frightened enemies within 10 ft (30 ft at L18) have 0 speed and take half your Paladin level in Psychic damage at turn start.

15.name: Scornful Rebuke
15.description: Attackers that hit you take Psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

20.name: Invincible Conqueror
20.description: Action grants Resistance to all damage, an extra Attack action attack, and critical hits on 19–20 for 1 minute (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace & Rebuke the Violent
3.description: Gain +5 Persuasion for 10 min or Reaction reflects Radiant damage equal to damage dealt by an attacker.

7.name: Aura of the Guardian
7.description: Reaction takes damage magically in place of an ally within 10 ft (30 ft at L18).

15.name: Protective Spirit
15.description: Regain 1d6 + half Paladin level HP at end of turn if below half HP.

20.name: Emissary of Redemption
20.description: Permanent Resistance to all damage from creatures you haven't attacked, and attackers take half damage back as Radiant.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete & Inspiring Smite
3.description: Adv on Athletics/Acrobatics & 2x carry/jump for 10 min, or Bonus Action after Divine Smite distributes 2d8 + level Temporary HP.

7.name: Aura of Alacrity
7.description: Your walking speed increases by 10 ft, and allies starting within 5 ft (10 ft at L18) gain +10 ft speed for that turn.

15.name: Glorious Defense
15.description: Reaction adds CHA mod to an ally's AC within 10 ft and allows a counter-attack if the attack misses (CHA mod/Long Rest).

20.name: Living Legend
20.description: Bonus Action empowers CHA checks, turns missed attacks into hits 1/turn, and rerolls failed saves as a Reaction for 1 minute (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will & Abjure the Extraplanar
3.description: Grant CHA mod allies Adv on INT/WIS/CHA saves for 1 min, or Turn Aberrations/Celestials/Elementals/Fey/Fiends.

7.name: Aura of the Sentinel
7.description: You and allies within 10 ft (30 ft at L18) add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative rolls.

15.name: Vigilant Rebuke
15.description: Reaction deals 2d8 + CHA Force damage whenever a creature forces you/allies within 30 ft to make an INT/WIS/CHA save.

20.name: Mortal Bulwark
20.description: Bonus Action gains 120 ft Truesight, Adv vs extraplanar foes, and banishment hits for 1 minute (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Channel Divinity: Control Undead & Dreadful Aspect
3.description: Command a low-CR Undead for 24h or frighten enemies within 30 ft for 1 minute.

7.name: Aura of Hate
7.description: You, nearby Fiends, and Undead within 10 ft (30 ft at L18) add +CHA mod to melee weapon damage rolls.

15.name: Supernatural Resistance
15.description: Gain Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

20.name: Dread Lord
20.description: Project a 30-ft aura of gloom for 1 min dealing 4d10 Psychic damage to frightened foes and allowing shadow attacks (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge & Turn the Tide
3.description: Compel nearby enemies not to move beyond 30 ft, or Bonus Action heals injured allies 1d6 + CHA mod.

7.name: Divine Allegiance
7.description: Reaction substitutes your own HP to absorb all damage dealt to a creature within 5 ft.

15.name: Unyielding Spirit
15.description: Advantage on saving throws to avoid being Paralyzed or Stunned.

20.name: Exalted Champion
20.description: Action grants Resistance to nonmagical BPS, ally Adv on Death Saves, and Adv on WIS saves for 1 hour (1/Long Rest).
